note: Each copy holds src/ and checks/ of its side; the witness edits src/world.js only (anchors exact and unique), then node --test --test-reporter=tap checks/campaign-world.test.mjs runs whole in the copy. historical = the 6 legacy fingerprints, campaign mode opt-in, first three campaign worlds; v1Loop/v2Loop = the 18 + 18 campaign loops.

v2-armor.replacement: window.FWorld = { create: (seed, stage, options) => { const w = create(seed, stage, options); if (w.campaignVersion === 2) for (const g of w.destructibles) if (g.kind === 'wall') g.armor = 'heavy'; return w; }, validate, isWalkable, floorHeight };

v1-armor.replacement: window.FWorld = { create: (seed, stage, options) => { const w = create(seed, stage, options); if (w.campaign === true && w.campaignVersion !== 2) for (const g of w.destructibles) if (g.kind === 'wall') g.armor = 'heavy'; return w; }, validate, isWalkable, floorHeight };

native-trig.replacement: const FMath = { sin: Math.sin, cos: Math.cos, atan: Math.atan, atan2: Math.atan2, hypot2: Math.hypot, hypot3: Math.hypot };
